citations.assessment: The Bavli identifies Hillel son of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani as the speaker in the prayer discussion.
Rabbi Levi replies directly to Hillel son of Shmuel bar Nachmani. This sentence does not give Levi’s own patronymic.
Hillel son of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani explains the eye-paint baraita as applying to city women.
The full patronymic ends in Nachman. Hillel interprets the spelling of Yeshua in Nehemiah.
Hillel has the same patronymic in the teaching on the compensation of a master and student.
The Midrash gives the same patronymic and the Yeshua interpretation in the discussion of successive generations.
The Yerushalmi gives the same patronymic and the interpretation about the honor of the righteous.
